title: CRIC Software Architecture Specification
summary: Defines CRIC's implementation architecture: layer stack, languages, Pydantic schema authority, storage, agent runtime, repository dependency direction, deployment profiles and v0.1 acceptance criteria.
notes: H1 self-declares 'Specification'; content is implementation contracts (stack choices, dependency direction, workspace layout, config precedence, CI gates) -> SPEC. Contains a 'v0.1 Acceptance Criteria' section (a PRD hallmark), but those criteria are architectural/implementation properties, not user-facing requirements, and there are no user stories or success metrics; dominant signals remain SPEC. No frontmatter, no status field, no ADR Context/Decision/Consequences structure, so not ADR. No markdown links present; repository names (cric-core, cric-knowledge, etc.) are mentioned as repos, not document paths, so cross_refs is empty.
